_comment: Mid-engine V8 sports car with an eight-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Reference: 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray Z51 ; model: Sketchfab 2019 Chevrolet Corvette C8 Stingray by Haris3D (CC BY 4.0).
name: Corvette Stingray Z51 (C8)

sources.calibration: Car and Driver: 2.8 s to 60 mph and 149 ft from 70 mph (first test), 148 ft and 1.03 g (long-term 2021 Z51); 3647 lb measured; 40/60 weight split (Chevrolet). The 0-60 target is timed with Car and Driver's 1 ft rollout (target_0_60_rollout).
sources.engine: 495 hp at 6450 rpm, 470 lb-ft at 5150 rpm with the Z51 exhaust (Chevrolet); curve shape estimated.
sources.gearing: TREMEC TR-9080 dual clutch: 2.91/1.76/1.22/0.88/0.65/0.51/0.40/0.33, reverse 2.63; Z51 final drive 5.17 (1.46 transfer gear x 3.55 ring and pinion; National Corvette Museum gear table, corvsport 2022 specifications).
sources.tyres: Staggered 245/35ZR19 front, 305/30ZR20 rear: the rear axle grips 25 % harder (axle_grip, estimate); the model uses one rolling radius, the rear's.
sources.launch: Automatic launch at 3000 rpm at full pedal (1800 + 1200 per unit of throttle; estimate, 580 Nm on this curve). The launch is tyre-limited with traction control on, so a higher speed only revs the engine longer before the clutch bites (4000 rpm: 3.61 s, 3000 rpm: 3.58 s on CarTrack).
sources.estimates: Centre of gravity, inertia (scaled, 15 % less yaw for the mid engine), spring and bar rates (2.0/2.2 Hz), dampers, launch, brakes, tyre grip (calibrated).
sources.launch_control: Launch control holds about 3500 rpm on the 2020 Stingray (owners' reports on CorvetteForum and ACS Composite's guide; the service text names 3000 rpm as the minimum; unofficial). The bench times it as the magazines do: brake and full throttle held 2 s, the clock starting on the release.

calibration_open: 0-60 mph 3.22 s with Car and Driver's 1 ft rollout (3.53 s from rest) against their 2.8 s. Launch control (3500 rpm) and the real TR-9080 ratios are modelled; the launch is limited by rear-tyre grip on the legacy tyre curve. The physics lane's TMeasy fit gives 3.31 s from rest (about 3.0 s with rollout).

card.handling: Mid-engine balance: 1.03 g on the skidpad (Car and Driver, Z51); a variable-ratio electric rack; stable on lift-off with stability control.
card.sources: Turning circle 38.1 ft: Edmunds 2020 Corvette Stingray specifications. Curb 3,535 lb: Edmunds. Weight split 39.4/60.6: Corvette Story 2020 specifications. Steering 15.7:1: Chevrolet 2020 specifications. Skidpad: Car and Driver long-term Z51.
